text:
alex: Quick flag — p95 for /v1/generate spiked on the canary slice this morning. p50 steady, p99 fine. anyone else see that? :eyes:
mina: can you share the console slice? is it the merged route or origin-specific?
alex: pasted: endpoint=/v1/generate canary p50=78ms p95=420ms p99=980ms samples=1.6k (merged)
sam: deploy-bot shows canary weight wiggle at 09:12. also fallback events at 09:14 that added ~200ms for some requests.
jordan: could be kvcache misses inflating p95. our dashboard default merges origins which hides that nuance.
mina: agree. telemetry needs to guarantee origin tags (ingress/kvcache_hit/backend). if missing, UI shouldn't claim backend-only.
ui-ux-beth: UI idea: small provenance badge next to percentiles: "merged" or "origin:backend". clickable -> expand per-origin p50/p95/p99 and counts.
sam: I'll add the explicit origin field in telemetry and try backfill for 48h. ETA 48h.
alex: can we also add a canary alert that splits p95 by origin? would have caught this earlier.
mina: low-effort alert: trigger if p95_merged - p95_backend > 50ms AND samples>200.
ui-ux-beth: I'll mock badge + hover details and post in #design-review by EOD.
alex: owners: ui-beth for badge, sam for telemetry, docs for wording (jordan). thanks — this clears up the spike for now. :thumbsup:
